CustomField.description: How often autosave runs when Enable Autosave is on. Upon Change, the default, saves 3 seconds after the respondent's last change, and at least every 15 seconds during continuous typing. Every 10 Seconds and Every 30 Seconds save on a timer that starts with the first change, skips any interval with nothing new, and pauses after each save until the respondent changes something again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose how autosave paces itself. "Upon Change" saves 3 seconds after the respondent stops making changes (at most 15 seconds after the first unsaved change during continuous typing) and is the recommended default; the timed options save on a 10- or 30-second checkpoint clock that only runs while the respondent is actively working and never saves when nothing changed.
CustomField.label: Autosave Mode
